codeScatter.title: Code generates, but products struggle to ship
codeScatter.desc: Pure code generation is fast, but often lacks process, review, and traceable collaboration.

agentChaos.title: Multi-agent collaboration is hard to control
agentChaos.desc: Task decomposition, context sync, execution status and results review are often scattered across multiple tools.

costRise.title: Post-launch maintenance costs keep rising
costRise.desc: Without reusable workflows and memory systems, teams rebuild the same processes repeatedly.

lifecycle.title: Complete lifecycle, you're always in control

difference.q: What's different between Viben and traditional AI coding assistants?
difference.a: Viben focuses on 'multi-agent workflow orchestration', not just code generation, but also task management, review checkpoints, and continuous iteration.

model.q: Do I need to use a specific model?
model.a: No. Viben is based on the MCP ecosystem and can integrate with various models and clients, freely combining according to team habits.

audience.q: Is it suitable for individual developers or teams?
audience.a: Both. Individuals can use it to build stable automation workflows, teams can unify collaboration standards and improve delivery efficiency.
